name: Microsoft Learn Research
description: Search Microsoft Learn documentation and retrieve official code samples through Microsoft's public MCP server.
longDescription: An importable Helix plugin maintained by Advai that connects to the public, read-only Microsoft Learn MCP server. It supports documentation research, full-page retrieval, and official code-sample discovery without requiring an account or access token.

skills.name: microsoft-docs-research
skills.description: Research Microsoft and Azure topics using official documentation, then fetch full pages when more context is required.

skills.name: microsoft-code-samples
skills.description: Find current code examples from Microsoft Learn for Azure, .NET, Microsoft 365, and related developer platforms.

starterPrompts: Find the current Microsoft Learn guidance for Azure Container Apps scaling.
Show an official C# example for authenticating with Azure Identity.
Compare two Microsoft Learn pages and summarize the differences.
